title: Mission: Frog & Tadpole
subtitle: Build the frog and see how it grows from a tadpole.
summary: Meet the frog and tadpole, learn their parts, and see the life cycle.
activityInstruction: Watch the tadpole grow into a frog.

storyQuestions.prompt: What does a tadpole grow into?
storyQuestions.success: A tadpole grows into a frog.

storyQuestions.prompt: What do frogs use to jump?
storyQuestions.success: Frogs jump with their strong back legs.

storyQuestions.prompt: What do tadpoles use to swim?

quiz.prompt: Which part helps the frog jump?
quiz.success: The strong back legs help the frog jump.

quiz.prompt: What does the tadpole lose as it grows?
quiz.success: The tadpole loses its tail as it grows.

quiz.prompt: What do frogs catch bugs with?
quiz.success: Frogs catch bugs with their long tongue.

parts.label: Body
parts.fact: The frog's body holds its organs and gives it its shape.
parts.help: The big round middle of the frog.

parts.label: Back Leg
parts.fact: The strong back legs push the frog into the air when it jumps.
parts.help: The long folded leg on the side.

parts.label: Eye
parts.fact: The frog's big eyes sit on top of its head so it can see while in the water.
parts.help: The round bump on the head.

parts.label: Tadpole
parts.fact: The tadpole is the baby frog that swims with a tail before it grows legs.
parts.help: The small swimming shape beside the frog.

parts.label: Tongue
parts.fact: The frog's long tongue snaps out fast to catch bugs.
parts.help: The line coming from the mouth.
